Assalomu alaykum! Men — Ishonch.

🔎 Istalgan e'lonning (OLX, Telegram, Instagram) skrinshoti yoki matnini yuboring — narx va firibgarlik xavfini baholayman.

Yoki quyidagi tugma orqali ilovani oching.
